name: Lovely Heroines
source:
New Dork City is in danger! A dangerous alien overlord arrived and is threatening to enslave all humanity! Only a very powerful hero will be able to save us! Are you ready?

However, the only way to increase your power is to search other Heroines and have fun with them! Meet as many as you can and save the city!

A sexy parody of superhero comics and movies, where you must search multiple Heroines to stop a powerful evil villain.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1170290/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
新呆瓜市危在旦夕！一名危险的外星霸主降临，扬言要奴役全人类！只有一位极其强大的英雄才能拯救我们！你准备好了吗？

然而，提升力量的唯一办法，就是找到其他女英雄，与她们共度欢愉时光！尽可能多地结识她们，拯救这座城市吧！

这是一部性感的超级英雄漫画与电影恶搞作品。你必须寻找多位女英雄，阻止一名强大的邪恶反派。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1170290/]Steam[/url]]
